verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud offers a hosted v4 HTTP API at api.browser-use.com with an API-key-secured POST Create Run endpoint (client.runs.create with a natural-language task). Results come back as run.result, and run progress can be polled via runs.events() with a cursor. Browsers are managed cloud Chromium with stealth, proxies and CAPTCHA solving by default, so the agent never runs a browser itself. Missing for 10: no evidence of registrable webhook callbacks for run completion, no independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted run-and-poll flow.
